name: Tachibana Saki
source:
Cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Tachibana Yuuji[/url]. She lives in Hokkaido, a wintery region of Japan, with her dad at a closed-down inn.

She is a classic tsundere much to the woe of Yuuji. She is good at cooking as well as cleaning and shoveling snow, also has her own patent elbow drop.

[spoiler]She first met Yuuji during her childhood at a family member's wedding in the local shrine.[spoiler]
